title: 第115章 归一第114章 奕
slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
整座莲心台，开始向内坍缩。
黑白纹路不再是你推我挡的棋局，所有黑纹同时活了过来，像无数条黑龙拧成一股，朝着莲心古莲的根部疯狂汇聚。散逸在尘白界各处的寂念、鬈曲靖里沉浮的残魂、五座禁锢泄露的王侯气息、无螽原上漂浮的万古死意，都循着冥冥中的牵引穿过层叠空间，往莲座底下的罪熵原点汇去。
归寂教主站在黑纹潮头，双臂张开，黑袍在坍缩的风压里猎猎作响。他仰头望着不断收缩的莲台，声音里带着近乎朝圣的狂热：
“看到了吗？这就是归一。”
“万古以来散逸的所有寂念，五位王侯的残魂，战死的军团，沉眠的旧神……所有属于沉寂的东西，终将重归原点。”
“天地万法，最后都会走向唯一的答案——寂灭归一。”
凌渊握剑的手微微一沉。
纯白的火种之力还在往莲茎里注入，可一股恐怖的吸力从地底传来，像一张无底巨口，要把他的烬莲火种连根拔起，拽进罪熵原点里一同归一。不止是他，封吟周身的花瓣在疯狂震颤，生息之力被黑纹扯着往外飘；姝橦的空间壁垒刚成型就被坍缩的空间绞碎，银链上爬满细碎的黑纹，连空间法则都在被寂念缓慢同化。
“不行，这样下去我们的力量都会被吸进去！”姝橦银链狂舞，试图撑开一片独立空间，可周遭的空间都在往原点塌陷，她的法则像投入漩涡的碎石，转眼就被吞没。
守莲人站在莲座之巅，素白的衣袍被风压得紧贴身躯。她望着脚下飞速蔓延的黑纹，轻声开口，声音穿过呼啸的风压，清晰地落在每个人耳中：
“他说的没错。寂念的尽头，是归一。”
“可生息的尽头，也是归一。”
她抬手，指尖点向自己眉心。笼罩在面容上的薄雾散去少许，露出半截素净的下颌，和一点淡金色的莲纹。随着她的动作，整座尘白界的生息之力都开始涌动——鬈曲靖里的纸鸢亮起微光，无螽原下的残魂轻轻震颤，五座禁锢缝隙里泄露的点点生光，都循着相反的轨迹，往莲心台汇聚而来。
“龙帝当年布下五座秘境，设下封寂弈，从来不是要把寂念赶尽杀绝。”守莲人的声音很轻，却带着万古的厚重，“死灭过盛则沉，生息过盛则浮。他要守的，从来不是一边倒的胜利，是归一的平衡。”
凌渊心头剧震。
神魂中的莲台道种缓缓旋转，烬莲火种忽明忽暗。他忽然想起在无螽原上悟出的生灭之火，想起祈天坛上花与火的相融，想起鬈曲靖里折叠的生死与共——原来从始至终，对抗寂念的办法从来不是焚烧殆尽，是共生，是归一。
“封吟，把你的花力渡给我。”凌渊忽然开口，“姝橦，用空间法则做界。”
两人同时一怔，随即毫不犹豫地点头。
封吟指尖一弹，一滴金色精血化作莹白光点，飞入凌渊身后的火种虚影；姝橦银链在空中划出一道浑圆的轨迹，空间之力折叠成球形的框架，将三人笼罩其中。凌渊站在最中心，断剑横于胸前，烬莲火种从丹田中腾空而起，悬在三人头顶。
“烬莲·生灭归一。”

凌渊轻声念诀，双手缓缓合拢。
金红的火种、莹白的花力、淡蓝的空间法则，三种截然不同的力量没有互相排斥，反而在空间框架里缓缓旋转、交融。生中有灭，灭里含生，空间为界，循环往复。它们没有变成同一种力量，却归于同一个本源，像一个微缩的天地，自成循环，生生不息。
当这团归一的光团落下，印在古莲莲心的瞬间，疯狂坍缩的莲台骤然一停。
正在往原点汇聚的黑纹顿住了，倒灌的吸力消失了，连地底罪熵原点的脉动，都慢了一拍。
归寂教主脸上的狂热僵住了。
“不可能……归一只能是寂念的归一！生息散乱不堪，怎么可能归一！”
他猛地一掌拍向地面，所有黑纹同时暴涨，地底的罪熵原点发出一声沉闷的轰鸣，一股漆黑的光柱从古莲根部冲天而起，带着吞噬一切的威势，直直撞向那团生灭归一的光球。
“给我散！”
黑柱与光球相撞的瞬间，没有惊天动地的爆炸声。
整座莲心台彻底静止了。
时间、空间、风声、脉动，所有的一切都停在了相撞的那一刻。黑白二色以碰撞点为中心，缓缓向外扩散出一圈圈涟漪，涟漪所过之处，黑纹与白纹不再厮杀，而是沿着弧线交错、相融，形成一幅巨大的阴阳鱼纹，印在莲台之上。
content_en:
The entire Lotus Heart Terrace began to collapse inwards.
The black and white lines are no longer a chess game where you push and I block, all the black lines come to life at the same time, like countless black dragons twisting into one, converging crazily towards the roots of the ancient Lotus Heart Lotus. The lonely thoughts scattered throughout the dusty white world, the remnant souls floating in the curling Jingjing, the aura of the princes leaking from the five prisons, and the eternal death floating on the Innocent Plains all follow the pulling force from the dark through the layered space and converge towards the origin of sin entropy under the rosette.
The leader of Guiji stood at the head of the black patterned tide, his arms spread wide, and his black robes rustled in the collapsing wind pressure. He looked up at the shrinking lotus platform, his voice almost filled with the enthusiasm of a pilgrim:
"See? This is unification."
"All the thoughts of silence that have been scattered for eternity, the remaining souls of the five princes, the legions who died in battle, the sleeping old gods...all the things that belong to silence will eventually return to their origin."
"All laws in the world will eventually lead to the only answer - annihilation and unity."
Ling Yuan's hand holding the sword sank slightly.
The power of pure white fire was still pouring into the lotus stem, but a terrifying suction force came from the ground, like a bottomless giant mouth, trying to uproot his Ember Lotus fire and drag it into the origin of sin entropy to reunite it together. Not only him, the petals around Feng Yin were trembling crazily, and the power of life was pulled outward by the black lines; the space barrier of Shulu was crushed by the collapsing space as soon as it was formed, the silver chain was covered with fine black lines, and even the laws of space were slowly assimilated by Ji Nian.
"No, if this continues, our power will be sucked in!" Shulu danced her silver chain wildly, trying to open up an independent space, but the surrounding space was collapsing toward its origin, and her laws were like gravel thrown into a whirlpool, swallowed up in the blink of an eye.
The lotus keeper stood on the top of the rosette, his plain white robe pressed tightly against his body by the wind. She looked at the rapidly spreading black lines under her feet and spoke softly. Her voice passed through the howling wind pressure and fell clearly on everyone's ears:
"He is right. The end of silent thoughts is the return to unity."
"The end of life is also the end of oneness."
She raised her hand and pointed her fingertips to the center of her eyebrows. The mist covering his face dissipated a little, revealing half of his plain lower jaw and a little pale golden lotus pattern. Following her movements, the life force of the entire Chenbai Realm began to surge - the paper kites in the Curly Palace shimmered, the remnant souls under the Wuqi Plain trembled slightly, and the little bits of light leaking from the gaps in the five prisons all followed opposite trajectories and converged towards the Lotus Heart Terrace.
"The Dragon Emperor set up five secret realms and set up Feng Jiyi. He never wanted to drive Ji Nian away." The voice of the lotus guardian was very soft, but it carried the weight of eternity. "Death and destruction will lead to sinking, and life and prosperity will float. What he wants to protect is never a one-sided victory, but a unified balance."
Ling Yuan's heart was shocked.
The lotus seed in the soul rotates slowly, and the embers of lotus fire flickers on and off. He suddenly remembered the fire of birth and death that he had realized on the Innocent Plain, the fusion of flowers and fire on the Temple of Prayer to Heaven, and the sharing of life and death in the Curly Jingli - it turned out that from beginning to end, the way to fight the thought of silence was never to burn it out, but to coexist and unify.
"Feng Yin, give me your flower power." Ling Yuan suddenly said, "Shu Piao, use the laws of space to create boundaries."
The two of them were startled at the same time, then nodded without hesitation.
With a flick of Feng Yin's fingertips, a drop of golden blood turned into a point of bright white light and flew into the shadow of the fire behind Ling Yuan; the silver chain drew a round trajectory in the air, and the power of space folded into a spherical frame, enveloping the three of them. Ling Yuan stood in the center, with a broken sword across his chest, and embers of fire rose from his dantian, hanging above the heads of the three of them.
"Ember Lotus·The unity of birth and death."
Ling Yuan recited the incantation softly and slowly closed his hands.
The golden-red fire, the white flower power, and the light blue space law, these three completely different forces did not exclude each other, but instead slowly rotated and blended in the space frame. There is destruction within birth, and birth within destruction. Space is the boundary, and the cycle goes back and forth.They have not become the same force, but have returned to the same origin, like a miniature world, forming a cycle of their own and endless.
When this unified ball of light fell and was imprinted on the heart of the ancient lotus, the crazily collapsing lotus platform suddenly stopped.
The black lines that were converging towards the origin paused, and the incoming suction disappeared. Even the pulse of the origin of the underground sin entropy slowed down a beat.
The fanaticism on Guiji's face froze.
"It's impossible... the unification can only be the unification of silent thoughts! How can it be possible to unify when the life and breath are so scattered!"
He slammed his palm to the ground, and all the black lines surged at the same time. The origin of sin entropy under the ground let out a dull roar, and a jet-black light pillar rose into the sky from the roots of the ancient lotus. With the power of devouring everything, it hit the ball of light that unified life and death.
"Let me go!"
The moment the black pillar collided with the light ball, there was no earth-shattering explosion.
The entire Lotus Heart Terrace was completely still.
Time, space, wind, pulse, everything stopped at the moment of collision. With the collision point as the center, the black and white colors slowly spread outward in circles of ripples. Wherever the ripples pass, the black and white lines no longer fight, but intersect and merge along the arc, forming a huge yin and yang fish pattern, printed on the lotus platform.
